name: Inversionista (Investor) Resident Status

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum investment of PEN 500,000 in a new or existing Peruvian company, fully subscribed and paid in cash in a single bank transfer through a Peruvian-regulated financial entity.
requirements.fix_path: Transfer at least PEN 500,000 into a new or existing Peruvian company via a single verified bank transfer.

requirements.blocker_text: A public deed (escritura pública) of company incorporation or capital increase, issued within the last 3 months, registered with SUNAT.
Apostilled and Spanish-translated criminal background certificates from country of origin, plus Interpol clearance.

evidence_required.document: Bank transfer SWIFT confirmation and bank letter confirming deposit of PEN 500,000+
Company incorporation or capital-increase deed (escritura pública)

outcome.duration_length: 365 days, renewable annually while the investment is maintained

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.f: Inversionista resident status exists in law, with the investment amount and conditions explicitly deferred to administrative regulation ('El monto de la inversion... sera fijado en el Reglamento')

Immigration consultancy -- Peru Investor visa: PEN 500,000 minimum investment, single-transaction bank transfer, company deed and RUC/SUNAT registration, business plan targeting ~5 jobs created, 365-day validity
